reports.context: DeMar DeRozan said he was discussing a trade to Denver Nuggets. The report lists Aaron Gordon as a current Nuggets player but reports no new development concerning him.
reports.title: DeMar DeRozan discusses trade talks

review: The report has already been selected upstream. Preserve DeRozan as the speaker discussing a trade; never transfer his claim to Gordon.
